text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
Nothing comes to mind
any longer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: I can't visualize a straight trajectory of light leading to the finish line at all.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Could it be that... my analysis of positioning and stamina around me was lacking...?
choice_data_list: Light O, you can keep it more simple, you know
Instead of thinking, let's get moving!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: What kind of running style you like.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Of course, shooting out at top speed—

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"Crossing the finish line before anyone else.
Because that is what leads to 'maximum speed.'"
choice_data_list: Then forget all distractions and just run looking straight ahead.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
In other words—burst out of the gate with a *bam*,
blaze down the track with a *whoosh*, and cross the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
I see. Keeping it simple really helps.
For the next race... I'll run without thinking about a thing...!

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
choice_data_list: First, back to training. In the end, that's the fastest way.
First, back to training. In the end, that really is the shortcut.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"If you become faster than anyone else...
then you are the fastest."

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text: Splendid. No directive could be clearer.

text_block_list.name: Calstone Light O
text_block_list.text:
"A speed that can overwhelm everyone regardless of strategy...
I will show you that I can master it."
